service.description: The subscriptions of this process: running, and ended without an unsubscribe.

parameter.name: claimStartup
parameter.description: true: claim the startup restoration; startupClaimed is true for the first claim in this process only.

service.description: The identity and scope of a gateway, as the former gateway checked them. The gateway must be a Device with a PhysicalDevice and a DgmpEdgeGateway member of at least one DeviceGroup (statusId empty or DgmsAlive). Its scope is those groups and their alive members, recursively; the controllers of the scope are the members with a controller purpose (DgmpProcessPLC, DgmpSafetyPLC, DgmpController, DgmpMotionController, DgmpRemoteIO, DgmpSafetyRemoteIO, DgmpExtremeConditionRemoteIO).

The subscriptions a gateway starts: the active (fromDate, thruDate) DeviceRequest records of type DrtSubscribe, DrtEvent, DrtStateChange or DrtCyclic, run by a service of this component, whose device is a controller in the scope of the gateway (get#GatewayScope); ordered by priority, sequenceNum, requestName.

Starts the subscriptions of the gateway. The first call in a process starts get#StartupSubscriptions: the subscriptions of the controllers in the scope of the gateway (property device_gateway_device_id; without it nothing is restored). A later call restarts only the subscriptions that ended without an unsubscribe (a lost connection). An unsubscribed request stays stopped until it is run again.
The service job start_DeviceGatewaySubscriptions calls it every minute: mr-moqui has no startup hook, so the first run after a start restores the subscriptions. Set the property device_gateway_restore_subscriptions to false on an instance that must not own the subscriptions.
